magic_links_subject_check.name: magic_links_subject_check
magic_links_subject_check.value:
("magic_links"."kind" = 'worker' and "magic_links"."worker_id" is not null and "magic_links"."office_user_id" is null)
     or ("magic_links"."kind" = 'office' and "magic_links"."office_user_id" is not null and "magic_links"."worker_id" is null)

sessions_subject_check.name: sessions_subject_check
sessions_subject_check.value:
("sessions"."kind" = 'worker' and "sessions"."worker_id" is not null and "sessions"."office_user_id" is null)
     or ("sessions"."kind" = 'office' and "sessions"."office_user_id" is not null and "sessions"."worker_id" is null)

assignments_one_live_per_worker.name: assignments_one_live_per_worker
assignments_one_live_per_worker.where: worker_id is not null and status not in ('cancelled_worker', 'cancelled_firm')

assignments_confirmed_at_set.name: assignments_confirmed_at_set
assignments_confirmed_at_set.value: "assignments"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'no_show', 'completed') or "assignments"."confirmed_at" is not null

assignments_cancel_evidence.name: assignments_cancel_evidence
assignments_cancel_evidence.value:
"assignments"."status" not in ('cancelled_worker', 'cancelled_firm')
        or ("assignments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "assignments"."notice_hours" is not null
            and "assignments"."cancel_reason" is not null and length(btrim("assignments"."cancel_reason")) > 0)

credential_rules_required_types_format.name: credential_rules_required_types_format
credential_rules_required_types_format.value:
coalesce(array_ndims("credential_rules"."required_types"), 1) = 1
        and array_position("credential_rules"."required_types", null) is null
        and (cardinality("credential_rules"."required_types") = 0
          or (array_to_string("credential_rules"."required_types", ',') ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*(,[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)*$'
            and cardinality(string_to_array(array_to_string("credential_rules"."required_types", ','), ','))
              = cardinality("credential_rules"."required_types")))

requests_shift_required.name: requests_shift_required
requests_shift_required.value: "requests"."type" not in ('time_change', 'swap') or "requests"."shift_id" is not null

requests_resolution.name: requests_resolution
requests_resolution.value:
("requests"."status" in ('open', 'escalated') and "requests"."resolved_at" is null and "requests"."resolved_by" is null)
        or ("requests"."status" = 'auto_resolved' and "requests"."resolved_at" is not null)
        or ("requests"."status" in ('approved', 'declined') and "requests"."resolved_at" is not null and "requests"."resolved_by" is not null)
